links.outcome: AUC of AI-ECG alone versus models incorporating clinical risk scores on same patients
links.effect: AI-ECG alone AUC 0.64-0.69; models with CHADS2/CHA2DS2-VASc reached SVM AUC 1.00, AdaBoost 0.97-0.98, ANN 0.89-0.95; CHA2DS2-VASc was the most influential predictor.
links.quote: AI-ECG provides rapid, low-cost AF risk estimation from a single sinus rhythm ECG; however, its predictive performance is modest compared with clinical scores.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the diagnostic performance and explainability (SHAP) of an AI-enabled ECG system combined with clinical risk scores for atrial fibrillation risk stratification, but does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
